name: demo-mode-e2e
description: End-to-end: installs @playwright/test in a throwaway project, runs the skill's real scripts/demoMode.smoke.spec.ts in Chromium with video on (asserts off-screen scroll-to-target, label-ring for hidden inputs, a click hold of at least 3 s), pixel-checks the highlight ring in a mid-click screenshot, then builds an MP4 from two time ranges of the recording with the skill's real scripts/assemble-segments.sh and checks its duration and contact sheet.
